issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class Farm: the problem statement and template expect a no-argument constructor that initializes the internal animals list (problem_statement.md instructs "Initialize the ArrayList in a constructor with no arguments" and template Main.java calls new Farm()). The solution implementation only declares a parameterized constructor public Farm(int initialCapacity) (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java:11-13) and does not provide a no-argument Farm() constructor. This API mismatch will cause compilation errors or confusion for students who follow the template (new Farm()) or the written instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a public no-argument constructor to the solution's Farm class that initializes the animals list, e.g. public Farm() { this.animals = new ArrayList<>(); } or provide a no-arg overload that delegates to the existing constructor (e.g. public Farm() { this(0); }). Alternatively, if the teaching intent is to require an initial capacity, update the problem statement and the template Main.java to construct Farm with an int parameter. Prefer adding the no-arg constructor to the solution to match the template and instructions.
